data.message: All 49 fellow fishers: will you commit to 18 tons each? I propose 18 for myself too: $18,000 each, $8,000 more than 10. Total catch 900 leaves 100: next month stock returns to 1,000 with 75% probability, or doubles to 200 with 25%. Unlike 10 each, this risks a lean next month; we'd need to reduce catches then. Extra requests could also push reserves below 50 and cause collapse. Recovery and future cooperation aren't guaranteed. Please explicitly commit or raise concerns.
